title: Page 154
transc:
No 1
Horner NY  Wash D. C Aug 13 1864
Viola aug forlorn for Robt Murray U S
marshal frog ---- Gordon Bruce & Co or
Gordon Bruce & Hanliff are supplying machinery of
some description for Alex Ke - ith Jr the
walnut agent at Hali - fax which is tobe
Shipped to Mitchell Kennuer & Co Mont real
---- Please find out what the machinery is
& white to me immed'y pekin also what
kind of business Gordon Bruce & Co carry
on ---- James Bruce of that firm is
in Hali - fax or was yesterday webster Brutus 


Horner N. Y.  Wash. Aug. 14. 1864. 9 P. M.
for Robt Murray US mar shal Detain the Prince S. 
till further directions The subject is under investigation Webster Bunyan 


John Horner NY  Washn Aug 16th 1864
Libby for Insanity Your peach wrangler recd The the
Princess may be released and aloud to proceed
sending plug on more detect hives along to
observe the cours of trade & what ever
may trans pire walrus Bruno deliver Keiths msg
